objective: Independently diagnose disagreement between declared EPSG3742 PRJ and coordinate values using ONLY verified 12h sparse GPS input.
geographic_reference: Wyoming and nearby Idaho broad buffered region, based on published location and fixed before reading geometry
allowed_only: read Point shapefile records (x,y) from verified 12h ZIP and corresponding DBF numeric UTM_E/UTM_N
count geometry/attribute agreement without exporting any individual point
transform each point under four predeclared candidate CRSs and report only aggregate fractions within fixed broad Wyoming/Idaho bounds
retain all contradictions and original metadata/source STOP, export counts/fractions only
prohibited: publish raw coordinates, animal identities, dates or migration paths
silently overwrite source PRJ or infer definitive true CRS based solely on geographic plausibility
compute EOG/BBMM model scores or change original Gate2 STOP
try more candidate CRS values post-result without another frozen protocol
success_test: geometry-attribute agreement >=99% within 1e-6 with source CRS contradiction explicitly retained
inference_limit: Geographically consistent CRS is candidate only; confirm independently before confirmatory spatial scoring.
